nutshell: Today's items are dominated by the Nvidia leadership reversal, which put Jensen Huang back as CEO after a scandal and drew open White House involvement, showing how central the chip maker is to the AI economy. On the product side, agentic coding is maturing fast, with Claude Code adding JavaScript-based tool orchestration, Netflix retrofitting its development lifecycle for coding agents, and new GLM and Amazon moves signaling continued model and infrastructure competition.
